entries.reasoning: The hourly rates for Senior Data Engineer, Data Engineer, and BI Developer in the Lakeshore Rate Card are lower than the rates promised to Crestline ($85, $62, and $58 respectively) for substantially similar retail analytics and data engineering services while the Crestline MFN is active.

incomingClauses.quote: Senior Data Engineer | $72 | Data Engineer | $55 | BI Developer | $50

Time-and-materials work, change orders and any additional SOWs shall be charged at the rates set out in the Rate Card, which shall remain fixed for the first twenty-four (24) months of this Agreement.

entries.suggestedChange: Increase the hourly rates in Exhibit A to at least $85 for Senior Data Engineer, $62 for Data Engineer, and $58 for BI Developer to align with the Crestline MFN floor.
entries.impact: Collides with the Crestline MFN pricing promise which remains live until July 2027.
